final: WITH player_avgs AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM player_avgs) AS idx FROM player_avgs), hand_avgs AS (SELECT bats, AVG(idx) AS hand_avg_idx FROM indexed GROUP BY bats) SELECT i.player_id, i.bats, i.avg_doubles, i.idx AS player_index, i.idx - h.hand_avg_idx AS difference FROM indexed i JOIN hand_avgs h ON i.bats IS h.bats WHERE i.bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
